decisions.reason: Because this upholstery fabric is close to the firm's core offer and the firm has its own R&D, management can learn from market feedback and improve it, although the move from a standalone page in 2023 to only a mention in 2024 suggests somewhat weaker momentum.

This decorative fabric fits the firm's established design-led interior textile capabilities, and its continued website presence in both years indicates enough relevance to retain it while refining the offer.

A flame-retardant jacquard curtain fabric sits squarely within the firm's established functional interior textile knowledge, and its standalone presentation in both 2023 and 2024 signals strong commitment and market traction.
This wool-blend decoration fabric builds on existing materials and decoration know-how, so under strong absorptive capacity it is more likely to be improved and retained than removed.
The semi-transparent wool bouclé leno fabric extends familiar decorative textile competences, and the firm's R&D and broad collection strategy make continued marketing more likely than withdrawal.

Although newer, this braided-structure upholstery and curtain fabric builds directly on the firm's core upholstery and curtain business, and its own product page in 2024 suggests a promising launch worth keeping on the market.
